name: Lissajous
author: Erin Carter
description: A single bright phosphor dot traces a Lissajous figure on a near-black oscilloscope screen, trailing a tail of dimmer, wider samples. The frequency ratio drifts on a slow ~60s super-cycle, smearing into a woven knot then snapping into a simple resonance that holds steady before drifting on.

params.label: Trace speed
params.effect: Multiplies how fast the dot travels around the figure; high reads as a near-solid drawn curve, low as a lone wandering spark.

params.label: Persistence
params.effect: How far back along the path the tail reaches before fading out — a short comet at min, almost the whole closed figure in afterglow at max.

params.label: Figure size
params.effect: Half-extent of the Lissajous bounding box in CSS pixels, scaling the whole figure from a small centred emblem to nearly full-bleed.
